description: This vulnerability pattern occurs in blockchain execution layers that accept forkchoice updates from consensus layers without validating critical ancestry relationships. The core issue is the failure to enforce the invariant: finalized ⊆ safe ⊆ head (where ⊆ means "is an ancestor of or equal to").
trigger_condition: A Byzantine or buggy consensus client sends a forkchoice update where the head block is not a descendant of the finalized block, violating the fundamental chain ancestry invariant.
